problem: Let $c=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]$ and $d=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 6 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $c$ onto $d.$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{d}\,c & =\frac{c\cdot d}{d\cdot d}d \\  & =\frac{{c}_{x}{d}_{x}+{c}_{y}{d}_{y}+{c}_{z}{d}_{z}}{{d}_{x}^{2}+{d}_{y}^{2}+{d}_{z}^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 4+0\cdot 6+(-2)\cdot 2}{{4}^{2}+{6}^{2}+{2}^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{0}{{4}^{2}+{6}^{2}+{2}^{2}}d \\  & =⟨0,0,0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
